title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Key Points of the Work of the People's Courts in 2010
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Key Work Points of the People's Courts for 2010"

Fa Fa [2010] No. 1

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

We hereby print and distribute the "Key Work Points of the People's Courts for 2010" formulated by the Supreme People's Court to you. Please combine it with local actual conditions and conscientiously implement it. If any problems arise during implementation, please promptly report to this Court.

January 4, 2010

Key Work Points of the People's Courts for 2010

2010 is the last year for implementing the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, and the tasks of reform, development, and stability are very heavy. The overall requirements for the work of the people's courts are: conscientiously implement the spirit of the 17th National Congress of the Communist Party and the Fourth Plenary Session of the 17th Central Committee; conscientiously implement the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference and the National Conference on Political and Legal Work via Television and Telephone; always adhere to the "Three Supremes" work guiding ideology and the work theme of "Serving the Overall Situation and Administering Justice for the People"; deeply carry out the theme practice activity of "People's Judges for the People"; closely focus on the three key tasks of "resolving social conflicts, innovating social management, and ensuring fair and honest law enforcement"; grasp the first priority of law enforcement and case handling; vigorously strengthen self-construction; continue to deepen judicial reform; and strive to achieve new development in the work of the people's courts. After discussion by the Party Leadership Group of the Supreme People's Court, the key work points of the people's courts for 2010 are determined as follows:

I. Adhere to Serving the Overall Situation and Administering Justice for the People, and Effectively Implement the Party Central Committee's Major Strategic Deployments

1. Conscientiously implement the spirit of the National Conference on Political and Legal Work via Television and Telephone. Deeply study and understand the spirit of the conference, firmly grasp the source, fundamental, and basic issues affecting social harmony and stability; deeply advance the three key tasks of resolving social conflicts, innovating social management, and ensuring fair and honest law enforcement; incorporate them into the overall deployment of the people's court work, into all aspects of law enforcement and case handling, court reform, team building, etc., and into the performance assessment scope of leading bodies and leading cadres at all levels of courts; carefully study and propose work plans and implementation opinions, decompose and implement various tasks, and ensure the solid and effective advancement of the three key tasks.

2. Properly adjudicate all types of cases related to maintaining stable and relatively fast economic development. In accordance with the six tasks proposed by the Central Economic Work Conference, vigorously strengthen civil and commercial trial work; lawfully and properly adjudicate various contract disputes, financing disputes, company liquidation, enterprise bankruptcy, equity disputes, tax collection and management, basic public services, and other cases arising from structural adjustment and expanding domestic demand; in accordance with the requirements of the "National Intellectual Property Strategy Outline", improve the intellectual property trial system and working mechanism, lawfully and properly adjudicate intellectual property cases; strengthen foreign-related commercial, maritime, and admiralty trial work, providing judicial services for promoting stable export growth and improving an open economic system.

3. Carefully adjudicate all types of cases involving people's livelihood. In response to issues that are currently relatively concentrated among the masses, lawfully and properly adjudicate cases concerning private lending, damages, as well as education, medical care, housing, social security, environmental protection, food and drug safety, land acquisition and demolition, labor disputes, and agriculture-related matters; strengthen administrative trial and state compensation work, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of the people, strive to improve the level of judicial supervision, and actively promote the improvement of administrative management and social management; for types of cases that are currently frequent and common, promptly research and formulate judicial response measures; for various prominent conflicts and mass disputes arising in economic and social development, firmly rely on the leadership of Party committees, actively seek support from the government and all sectors of society, and lawfully and properly resolve them.

4. Implement various measures to facilitate and benefit the people. Strengthen the construction of case-filing and petition reception windows, strive to achieve the goal of "sound systems, complete functions, adequate facilities, and satisfactory services"; improve systems such as first-query responsibility, service commitments, openness in case handling, and civilized reception; improve the summary procedures for civil and administrative litigation; improve work measures such as remote case-filing, circuit trials, appointment-based case handling, and separation of complex and simple cases; increase judicial assistance to disadvantaged groups.

5. Implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity. Grasp the focus and extent of leniency and severity, improve the standards for conviction and sentencing of relevant crimes, and promote the standardization of sentencing work. Lawfully severely crack down on criminal activities that endanger national security, disrupt social order, infringe upon the interests of the masses, undermine market order, and those involving embezzlement and bribery; intensify efforts to combat organized crime and eliminate evil forces; for those with statutory circumstances for leniency or mitigation of punishment, handle them leniently according to law. Strengthen the relief of criminal victims and the reconciliation of minor criminal cases, reduce social confrontation, and promote social harmony. Improve the criminal evidence system and standardize the death penalty review procedure.

6. Implement the principle of "mediation first, combining mediation with adjudication." Work hard to achieve the closure of cases and resolution of disputes, integrate mediation work into all stages including case-filing, trial, enforcement, appeals, and petitions; expand the scope of mediation, standardize judicial mediation procedures, focus on the quality of mediation, improve mediation efficiency, and strive to fundamentally resolve conflicts.

7. Improve the dispute resolution mechanism linking litigation and non-litigation. Improve the coordination and cooperation between litigation procedures and non-litigation dispute resolution methods such as arbitration, administrative mediation, and people's mediation; proactively strengthen collaboration with relevant departments, and actively promote the improvement and development of the litigation-mediation connection mechanism. Actively participate in comprehensive management of social order and peace creation activities.

II. Adhere to Strengthening Team Building, and Effectively Improve Team Quality

8. Deepen the theme practice activity of "People's Judges for the People." Continue to take the theme practice activity of "People's Judges for the People" as an important carrier for comprehensively strengthening the team building of the people's courts and promoting the scientific development of the people's courts; closely combine it with the actual situation of trial and enforcement work and team building; focus on promoting fair and honest justice; aim to improve judicial capacity and transform judicial style; focus on solving prominent issues strongly reflected by the masses; and further enhance judicial credibility.

9. Deepen ideological and political construction. In accordance with the requirements of building a learning-type Party organization and learning-type court, enhance self-awareness, improve systems, change the style of study, and achieve true learning, true understanding, true belief, and true application. Organize Party members and judges to deeply study and understand the basic theories of Marxism and the theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics, promote the Sinicization, modernization, and popularization of Marxist legal thought; deeply study and understand the socialist rule of law concept, consciously resist the influence of various erroneous thoughts, and ensure the healthy development of law enforcement and case handling, judicial reform, and other work. Actively promote research on trial theory, strengthen organizational leadership, and focus on studying difficult and key issues in the work of the people's courts; establish necessary incentive mechanisms, and strengthen the cultivation and construction of a talent team for trial theory research.

10. Deepen the Party building of the people's courts. Always place court work under the absolute leadership of the Party, adhere to the principle that the Party must govern the Party and strictly govern the Party, establish party branches in tribunals, improve the organizational life system, strengthen the Party spirit concept and Party member awareness of Party members, and assign the most arduous tasks and the most difficult problems to Party member judicial police to complete. Timely summarize fresh experiences created in various places, and vigorously promote the scientificization of Party building work. Conscientiously implement the Party building responsibility system, improve the Party building work assessment and evaluation system, and implement all the Party Central Committee's deployments on Party building at the grassroots level and put them into practice.

11. Deepen the construction of judicial integrity. Fully utilize both positive and negative role models and various effective methods, unremittingly carry out model education and warning education. Carefully summarize the practical experience of the anti-corruption struggle in recent years; for key positions and links prone to breeding corruption, further improve the mechanism for supervising and restricting the exercise of power, and improve the system of accountability for violations of discipline and law. Vigorously promote the system of integrity supervisors and judicial inspections, strengthen direct and real-time supervision over the judicial power and enforcement power. Establish and improve the system for handling online reports and letters regarding judges' violations of discipline and law, improve the mechanism for investigating reports, focus on investigating "cases involving relationships, personal connections, and money," and unswervingly implement the "Five Prohibitions."

12. Deepen the construction of judicial style. In response to the problems discovered in the major inspection of judicial style last year, further standardize judicial conduct, strictly follow judicial procedures, and strengthen judicial supervision. Further enhance judges' concept of the masses, effectively solve the problems of "where does power come from, for whom is justice administered, and on whom does justice rely," and increase affection for the masses. Improve the system for maintaining contact with the masses, and sincerely listen to the opinions of the masses. Pay attention to judicial etiquette, improve service attitude, and promote judicial civilization. Give play to the exemplary role of superior organs and leading cadres at all levels, and lead the majority of judges to transform their judicial style through concrete actions.

13. Deepen the construction of court culture. Deeply study and understand the socialist core value system, strengthen the construction of judges' professional ethics, and firmly establish the judicial core values of fairness, integrity, and serving the people. Always adhere to guiding by examples, pay attention to discovering, cultivating, and establishing advanced models, and fully leverage the exemplary, guiding, and radiating role of advanced models in the cultural construction of the people's courts. Vigorously strengthen public opinion publicity, and establish and maintain the good image of the people's courts as fair, honest, and serving the people.

III. Adhere to Deepening Judicial Reform, and Effectively Strengthen Institutional and Mechanistic Guarantees

14. Improve and perfect the trial management mechanism. The Supreme People's Court shall strengthen judicial interpretation work, timely issue specific opinions on implementing laws, guide courts at all levels to refine work standards for trial, enforcement, and petition handling, standardize judicial conduct and the exercise of discretion, and unify judicial scales. Strengthen trial performance evaluation work, combine work performance with the evaluation of excellence and promotion, forming a direction of selecting and employing people based on actual work performance. Improve the case quality assessment system and the law enforcement fault accountability system, and improve the trial supervision relationship between higher and lower courts. Establish and improve a scientific mediation work evaluation mechanism, incorporate the automatic performance rate of mediation cases and the rate of appeals and petitions into the evaluation system, and take case closure and dispute resolution as an important assessment standard. Strengthen enforcement work evaluation, increase the weight of the enforcement target realization rate and enforcement appeal rate in enforcement evaluation, so that assessment indicators fully reflect the level of enforcement work. Strengthen dynamic analysis of trial and enforcement work, strengthen the assessment of the case closure rate within the trial period, establish and improve a dynamic balance mechanism for case receipt and closure, strengthen the management responsibilities of court presidents and tribunal heads, and clarify the function of the trial supervision tribunal of grassroots courts to be responsible for case quality supervision and management. Higher courts shall strengthen the assessment and evaluation of the trial and enforcement work of lower courts, scientifically set evaluation indicators, focus on evaluating the effectiveness of trial and enforcement work, and promote the overall development of court work.

15. Improve and perfect the mechanisms for judicial openness and judicial democracy. Improve the system of judicial openness, lawfully disclose the contents of all stages including case-filing, court trials, and enforcement, and achieve sunshine justice and transparent openness through measures such as issuing news, establishing websites, setting up open days, publicly soliciting opinions on judicial interpretations, and gradually implementing the online publication of judgment documents. Improve the people's assessor system, appropriately increase the number of assessors, protect the right of assessors to participate in trials, and strengthen the management and training of assessors. Improve the mechanism for communication with public opinion, encourage judges to enter enterprises, rural areas, schools, and communities, and extensively listen to opinions from all sectors of society, experts, scholars, lawyers, and grassroots people; pay attention to collecting netizen opinions, carefully analyze and organize them, and timely formulate and implement rectification measures; establish a mechanism for analyzing and assessing public opinion trends and a communication mechanism with the news media, proactively release work information, and respond to social concerns. Improve the supervision mechanism, while strengthening internal supervision, more consciously accept supervision by the People's Congress, democratic supervision by the CPPCC, legal supervision by the procuratorial organs, and social supervision, to promote judicial fairness.

16. Improve and perfect the enforcement work mechanism. Based on the court itself, improve trial quality, establish a working mechanism for coordination and connection between case-filing, trial, and enforcement, lawfully apply litigation preservation measures, strengthen risk warnings before case-filing, and increase efforts in litigation mediation. Vigorously strengthen the standardization of enforcement work, further improve systems, strengthen supervision, and solve problems such as excessive seizure, evaluation and auction, suspension of enforcement, and seizure of property of persons not involved in the case; strictly apply the systems for enforcement objections and reconsideration, effectively protect the parties' rights to objection, reconsideration, and other remedies; improve the case flow management system for enforcement cases, focusing on solving problems of passive enforcement and delayed enforcement. Explore the establishment of systems such as rapid enforcement response, separation of powers and checks, property investigation and management, disposal of enforcement avoidance, response to violent resistance to law, entrusted evaluation and auction, analysis of enforcement errors and accountability, and management and supervision of entrusted enforcement cases. Focusing on improving the enforcement linkage mechanism, further strengthen communication and coordination with relevant departments, refine the specific responsibilities of relevant departments, and improve the joint meeting system for enforcement work. Fully leverage political advantages, consolidate and improve the new pattern of enforcement work featuring leadership by Party committees, supervision by the People's Congress, support by the government, hosting by courts, and cooperation by all sectors.

17. Improve and perfect the work mechanism for litigation-related petitions. Conscientiously implement the spirit of Document No. 22 issued by the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, implement the responsibilities of leaders and case handlers, implement the system of reverse accountability for responsibility, and ensure the quality of case handling; implement the principle of correcting errors according to law, and promptly conduct retrials for cases that meet the statutory conditions; implement systems such as regular reception of petitioners by leading cadres and higher courts bring cases for visits and circuit visits, guide petitions to move downward, and change the situation of leapfrog petitions; research and formulate regulations for the termination of petition cases, and terminate cases where reasonable demands and actual difficulties have indeed been resolved in accordance with relevant regulations; for those who truly have difficulties and need continued assistance, ensure their basic living through measures such as social relief.

IV. Adhere to Grasping the Construction of Grassroots Foundations, and Effectively Solidify the Foundation of Court Work

18. Continue to strengthen various measures to improve the capability and level of grassroots judges. Innovate judge training methods, focus on improving judges' ability to resolve social conflicts and do mass work. Vigorously promote activities such as judges teaching judges and on-the-job training, give play to the mentoring role of senior outstanding judges, sum up and promote effective methods in trial and enforcement work. Establish and improve a regular training system so that each judge can receive a certain amount of training every year. Continue to do a good job in training presidents of intermediate and grassroots courts. Fully leverage the role of the branches of the National Judges College in each province (autonomous region, municipality), start from 2010 to conduct rotational training for the presidents of dispatched people's tribunals of grassroots courts and form a system. Strengthen the cultivation of bilingual judges in ethnic minority areas. Continue to implement practices such as hierarchical selection of judges, two-way temporary exchange of judges between higher and lower courts, judges temporarily working and studying in Party and government departments, new personnel undergoing training at petition windows, and cultivating and rewarding model law enforcement and case handling personnel.

19. Continuously strengthen the supervision and guidance of higher courts over lower courts. Higher courts shall, in accordance with the principles of lawful supervision, independence of trial levels, and interaction between upper and lower levels, strengthen supervision and guidance over lower courts through methods such as inspection and supervision, issuing trial guidance documents, publishing guiding cases, organizing professional training, and holding professional seminars. Grasp the actual conditions of different regions, implement classified guidance, and avoid "one-size-fits-all" approaches. Listen to the opinions of grassroots judicial police, sum up and promote grassroots experiences, and enhance the pertinence and effectiveness of guidance. The Party leadership groups of higher courts shall strengthen communication and consultation with local Party committees, actively put forward opinions and suggestions on the allocation of leading bodies of lower courts, participate in the inspection work, strictly control the qualifications for holding office, cooperate with local Party committees in doing a good job of cadre exchange, and strengthen cadre supervision. Strengthen the professionalization of judges, promote the classified management of court staff, and establish and improve incentive mechanisms. Improve the management mechanism for judicial police and court clerks. Actively explore the methods, scope, and procedures for higher courts to supervise and guide lower courts in areas such as judicial police affairs, file management, administrative equipment, funding guarantees, information technology construction, and forensic identification management, straighten out working relationships, and improve working mechanisms.

20. Focus on solving the actual difficulties and problems at the grassroots level. Solve the issue of funding guarantees, in accordance with the requirements of the central government, rely on the leadership of local Party committees and the support of the government, implement the matching funds to be paid by local finance, and ensure the needs of office and case handling; solve the problem of unreasonable early departure of some judges, cooperate with relevant departments to study the establishment of a more adaptable establishment system, and alleviate the situation of many cases but few personnel and a fault line of judges; solve the issue of rank and treatment of grassroots judicial police, encourage outstanding judicial police to take root at the grassroots level, work hard and start businesses; solve the issue of the setup and working mechanism of people's tribunals in ethnic minority areas, reasonably adjust the layout, enrich personnel strength, and improve judicial conditions. Increase the positive publicity of grassroots work and grassroots judges, strengthen professional protection for judges, and resolutely deal with persons who retaliate against judges, violently resist enforcement, or disrupt court order according to law, to maintain the dignity of the law.

21. Focus on promoting the information technology construction of courts at all levels. In accordance with the requirements of "strengthening the court with technology," strengthen the construction of information technology infrastructure, promote the upgrading and improvement of hardware and software, and improve information processing capabilities; strengthen the construction of local area networks and wide area networks, fully utilize the network to carry out work such as document processing, file transmission, information release, personnel management, and logistics management, and improve work efficiency; strengthen the application of information technology in areas such as trial, enforcement, and petition handling, achieve comprehensive, dynamic, and real-time monitoring of various tasks, promote remote video interrogations and court hearings, and ensure the quality and efficiency of case handling; strengthen network security construction, and ensure the authenticity and reliability of information transmission and network services.
